opening.argument: The video presents a Coinbase signup promotion with stated conditions: viewers must create a new account, verify their identity, and complete a qualifying crypto purchase before a reward is credited. It also describes a first qualifying trade and says the reward is added once the requirements are met. The link is presented as applying the current promotion, while the description makes clear that any bonus depends on the promotion and purchase amount. The promoter discloses a possible commission from purchases through the links. These are the terms of a conditional signup offer, not evidence in the supplied material of deceptive conduct.

citations.quote: You typically have to create a new account, verify your identity, and complete a qualifying crypto purchase before the reward is credited to your account.
complete your first qualifying trade and your reward will be added automatically once the requirements are met.
This link automatically applies the current Coinbase promotion.
the actual bonus amount usually depends on the size of your first purchase and the current promotion.
when you make a purchase through our links, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you.
